visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) At the entrance of a club room, a host wearing glasses and a khaki shirt peeks through a glass door. A red diamond-shaped paper with the character for 'Spring' is taped to the door. (2) Inside the room, a male student in a gray t-shirt stands surrounded by anime posters and character standees. He speaks enthusiastically, gesturing with his hands. (3) A close-up shot shows a smartphone screen displaying a line graph illustrating a decline from BMI 28 to 25. (4) The scene transitions to an outdoor concrete staircase where a group of students in various shirts are walking and talking. (5) In a dimly lit indoor space, three performers execute highly synchronized, fast-paced dance moves while swinging glowing orange and blue lightsticks, creating light trails. (6) The host and the male student stand by a large window with natural light, engaging in a humorous interview with exaggerated facial expressions and laughter.
